ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface area, contrasted against a narrow low-intensity (black/dark) band along the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous high-intensity white zone occupies the central and proximal fluke areas. A distinct low-intensity black border follows the trailing edge, transitioning into brown/mottled clusters at the lateral terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with low pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) distributed continuously along the trailing edge from the notch to both tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex curvature fitted to the trailing edge of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters and circular textures are visible at the extreme distal points of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, mottled pigmentation and irregular edge textures at the lateral tips suggest site-specific scarring or previous parasitic colonization.
